en: The image depicts a sepia-toned monument in a formal garden, with a multi-story, classical-style building in the background. The monument is an obelisk with an eagle on top, plaques, inscriptions, and is enclosed by stone posts and chains. The upper left has printed red text 'Leitmeritz a. Elbe. Krieger-Denkmal.', and the bottom left corner reads '3307 Brück & Sohn, Meissen.'
